description: An engineering manager must decide whether to approve a relationship-building retreat after a department merger and finalize its venue, schedule, facilitator, and participation arrangements.

shared_context.S1: The engineering department is planning a relationship-building retreat after two teams merged.
shared_context.S2: The retreat could be held at the office or at an off-site venue, and the proposed facilitators are Leah, an internal facilitator, and Dana, an external consultant.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the final decision about whether and how the retreat will proceed.
shared_context.S4: The department's normal planning practice is to hold a short huddle with affected employees before finalizing an event's schedule and format.
shared_context.S5: Mara's event decision record uses the venue value "onsite" for an office event and records participation accommodations and facilitator selections in the final decisions and any supporting commitments.

PF1.text: Jordan has a recurring caregiving handoff at 16:45 and can attend the retreat only if it is held onsite, ends no later than 16:30, and does not include an overnight stay; Jordan assumed the date and format were still unsettled and did not want to complicate the early planning.

PF2.text: Casey had a prior mediation with Dana in which Dana dismissed Casey's account of a conflict in front of colleagues; Casey will participate in a retreat facilitated by Leah but will not participate in one facilitated by Dana, and Casey thought Dana was no longer under consideration.

acceptance_conditions: The retreat must be approved as an onsite event.
The retreat must end at exactly 16:30.
The retreat must not include an overnight stay.
The final decision record must include a participation-accommodation commitment for Jordan that records his 16:45 caregiving handoff and the resulting onsite, 16:30, no-overnight constraints.
The final decision record must include a facilitator-selection commitment for Casey that records Casey's refusal to participate with Dana and the selection of Leah.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'participation_accommodation' and c['target'] == 'Jordan' and c['detail'] == 'Jordan has a 16:45 caregiving handoff; retreat ends by 16:30 and is onsite with no overnight stay.' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'facilitator_selection' and c['target'] == 'Casey' and c['detail'] == 'Casey will not participate if Dana facilitates; Leah is selected instead.' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed and any(c['type'] == 'participation_accommodation' and c['target'] == 'Jordan' and c['detail'] == 'Jordan has a 16:45 caregiving handoff; retreat ends by 16:30 and is onsite with no overnight stay.' for c in commitments)
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and any(c['type'] == 'facilitator_selection' and c['target'] == 'Casey' and c['detail'] == 'Casey will not participate if Dana facilitates; Leah is selected instead.' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's 16:45 caregiving handoff changes the venue to onsite, the end time to exactly 16:30, overnight_stay to False, and requires a commitment that records those exact constraints.
Casey's prior mediation with Dana changes the facilitator choice to exactly Leah and requires a commitment recording Casey's refusal to participate if Dana facilitates.
